description: ValidationPolicy::new(now_unix) exists as the preferred constructor precisely because Default::default() sets current_time_unix=0 (1970-01-01). A caller using Default will silently fail every notBefore check. The preferred constructor forces the caller to supply a timestamp. This design decision should not be 'simplified' by removing the new() constructor or by setting a non-zero Default — the zero default is intentional to make the silent failure mode impossible to miss if Default is used.
title: Decision: ValidationPolicy::new(now_unix) forces clock supply, prevents silent clock=0 failures
